messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager P1 - Observability: Datadog ingestion backlog impacting metrics + logs (us-east-1 / eu-west-1). Runbook: observability-dd-backlog. Please ack and post current symptom summary.

jamie_oncall: ack. seeing lots of metric panels return `No Data` or stale values. Some alert groups firing repeatedly. Beginning triage now.

anna_sre: confirmed. Datadog metrics delayed ~10-40m depending on metric. Logs are arriving in bursts. Traces mostly ok. Looks like ingestion queue/backpressure upstream.

datadog-status: Status: "Ingestion delay affecting logs and metrics in multiple regions, prioritization and mitigation underway." https://status.datadoghq.com/incidents/67890

marco_infra: immediate mitigation options: 1) Failover critical alerting to our synthetic checks + CloudWatch metrics. 2) Temporarily mute noisy non-actionable alerts to reduce paging. 3) Start export of raw logs from local forwarders to S3 bucket `s3://redwood-obs-failover/dd-dump/` for the last 90m.

jamie_oncall: executing failover steps. Command used to flip alert channel: ```curl -X POST https://alert-manager.internal/api/v1/route -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"route":"synthetic_fallback","severity":["critical","high"]}'```

ops-bot: Alert routing changed to `synthetic_fallback` by jamie_oncall at 2241002525. Duplicate alert suppression enabled for datadog provider.

rachel_support: CS note: customers are reporting blank dashboards. I'm prepping a message: "We're aware of Datadog ingestion backlog affecting dashboards and alerts. We've activated fallbacks and are monitoring — updates every 30 minutes." Also compiling list of Dedicated customers with active SLAs.

michael_pm: Please include clear guidance to customers who rely on real-time alerts (recommend they treat current state as degraded monitoring). Also collect any customer reported incidents for correlation.

anna_sre: starting a focused run of ad-hoc checks against app instrumentation to establish customer impact. Querying internal metrics store for last-known good values. Example query: ```select avg(latency) from request_metrics where service='api' and ts > now() - 1h```

marco_infra: export started: `kubectl -n obs-forwarder exec forwarder-0 -- /usr/local/bin/forwarder dump --since=90m --out=s3://redwood-obs-failover/dd-dump/`

jamie_oncall: muting noisy alert groups for 20m: `alerts mute --provider datadog --group noisy-rules --duration 20m`

rachel_support: CS outreach list (initial): acct-177, acct-402, acct-999. Recommending manual verification for Dedicated customers with active SLAs.

anna_sre: note for telemetry: we have a blindspot roughly between 2241002100 and now for some per-request metrics. We'll need to rely on traces + customer reports for RCA. Save and tag exports `datadog-ingest-blindspot-2241002468`.

jamie_oncall: creating incident ticket INC-2024-211 and setting severity SEV2 (monitoring degraded, customers potentially affected).

ops-bot: Incident INC-2024-211 created by jamie_oncall. Pager duty reroutes active.

marco_infra: helper script for night handoff: ```#!/bin/bash
# quick datadog incident checks
curl -s https://status.datadoghq.com/incidents/67890 | jq -r '.updates[0].body'
aws s3 ls s3://redwood-obs-failover/dd-dump/ | tail -n 20
alerting-cli check --route synthetic_fallback --status
```

michael_pm: I'm drafting the public status update. Proposed: "Datadog is experiencing ingestion delays affecting some dashboards and alerts. We have enabled fallback alerting and are exporting logs. We will update every 30m." Approve to post?

rachel_support: approve. Posting now to status.redwood.com and sending to customer list.

anna_sre: small but important: do not auto-re-enable muted rules until Datadog confirms recovered AND we run a controlled re-enable to avoid alert storms. I'll prepare the playbook steps for re-enable.

jamie_oncall: handoff plan: I'll stay for one more update cycle then handoff to @night_oncall at 2241002800. Outstanding: keep exports running for 1h, monitor Datadog status, hold muted alerts, CS outreach confirmations.

night_oncall: ack and taking handoff at 2241002800. I have the handoff checklist. Will monitor for recovery and run restore workflow if status clear.

ops-bot: Handoff recorded: jamie_oncall -> night_oncall at 2241002800.

marco_infra: final notes before handoff: captured forwarder logs and pushed a snapshot to S3. Please retain bucket objects for 30 days for post-incident analysis.

anna_sre: creating post-incident ticket with timeline, exports, and mitigation steps. TAG: datadog-ingest-backlog, telemetry-blindspot.

jamie_oncall: last pre-handoff: Datadog status update still investigating. No full recovery observed. Handoff now. :white_check_mark:

rachel_support: CS: initial outreach sent. We'll follow up if customers confirm missed alerts. Logged affected accounts in INC ticket.

incident-bot: Reminder: run post-incident export and include `datadog-ingest-backlog` tag when closing.

night_oncall: taking it from here. Will update channel on any change.
